streams.title: Air Marshal: an integrated research programme
streams.summary: Combine the owner’s Ubuntu/Tello Air Marshal work with cognitive navigation, human intent, calibrated trust and collective reliability in one coherent research programme.
streams.state: Owner-confirmed direction; proposed integration and gap hypotheses, not established novelty.

flow.name: COORDINATE
flow.detail: Air Marshal roles and collective confidence

sections.title: How the research strands fit
paragraphs: Air Marshal is the shared software and experimental platform, grounded in the existing Ubuntu/Tello perception, logging, target-reacquisition and advisory visual-odometry work.

CRAN-0091: cognitive navigation and multisensor reliability under degraded observations. CRAN-0040: human–swarm collaboration and structured mission interpretation, as mapped in the existing local proposal matrix. CRAN-0041: trust sensing, adaptive autonomy and transparency, as mapped locally. Current official availability and numbering for 0040/0041 remain to be reverified.

Bristol small-swarm research supplies a collective-behaviour perspective: how confidence, coordination and task allocation change when individual robots or communication links become unreliable. University themes are research references; the programme remains the owner’s proposed synthesis.

sections.title: A bounded central research question
paragraphs: How can uncertainty about navigation and communication be propagated through small-team coordination to human-facing explanations and intervention decisions, so that a team remains useful without overstating its reliability?

The candidate contribution is a testable method for passing calibrated reliability information between these layers. Combining existing technologies is not sufficient to establish novelty. Compare against end-to-end prior art and demonstrate which coupling changes outcomes.

For a CRAN-0091-led proposal, choose navigation reliability as the primary contribution; use Air Marshal coordination and operator interaction as evaluation context. A 0040-led version can instead centre mission interpretation, while a 0041-led version centres trust calibration. This preserves one programme without promising three doctoral theses at once.

sections.title: Gap hypotheses and disconfirming evidence
paragraphs: G1 — Navigation-to-team confidence: test whether dependence-aware sensor confidence improves coordination under correlated errors. Compare independent confidence, simple averaging and a belief-propagation baseline; reject the hypothesis if gains disappear after matching communication and compute budgets.

G2 — Human intent under uncertainty: test whether structured mission interpretation with clarification reduces invalid or ungrounded plans relative to an unconstrained language interface and a deterministic command menu. First evaluate on offline annotated tasks.

G3 — Trust and intervention: test whether calibrated explanations improve appropriate intervention compared with a fixed-status display. This requires a separate human-study design, validated measures and appropriate institutional review before participant research.

G4 — Integrated benefit: compare navigation-only, coordination-only and coupled variants using identical frozen scenarios. Measure estimation error, confidence calibration, task completion, recovery time, message budget and latency. Integration that adds complexity without a measurable benefit is a negative result to retain.

sections.title: Staged experimental plan
paragraphs: Stage 1: catalogue current code, datasets and historical evidence; retain the 13 offline policy tests and the separately labelled July E013 flight record. The existing synthetic navigation baseline is preparation, not calibrated multisensor validation.

Stage 2: build a replay harness with independent truth, synchronized observations and seeded missing/bias/delay conditions. Add classical fusion and deterministic coordination baselines before learned reliability estimation.

Stage 3: add structured mission requests and a policy validator. Language-model output proposes plans; a separate validator and human oversight govern transitions. Record clarification, rejection and failure cases.

Stage 4: compare coupled and uncoupled variants with held-out scenarios, ablations and uncertainty estimates. Move to suitable calibrated hardware only after simulation/replay results and an explicit experimental plan.

AIOS/RRIS can organise queries, source provenance, deduplication and experiment records. AWS presents curated evidence and can later host offline analysis; latency-sensitive robotics remains at the edge. Financial research contributes temporal-validation discipline, not evidence that a robotics method works.

sections.title: Prior-art search and evidence gates
paragraphs: Search intersections as well as individual topics: uncertainty-aware human–swarm interaction; sensor-fusion confidence in multi-robot task allocation; correlated sensing errors and collective decision-making; trust calibration under degraded navigation; LLM mission planning with uncertainty and clarification.

Use AirSwarm, Bristol collective-ranking work and human–robot trust/mission-planning research as starting points. Track full-text inclusion, exact methods, datasets, comparison baselines and reasons for exclusion. The existing targeted refresh is not a complete systematic search.

Keep a claim-to-source matrix with support, contradiction and untested status. Promote a gap only after competing work has been examined and a feasible discriminating experiment specified. No evidence-readiness score is increased merely by combining the themes.

sections.title: What is implemented
paragraphs: The inspected E012 code uses one frame receiver and decoder, a latest-only shared-frame bus, OpenCV ORB monocular visual odometry and a non-commanding search advisor. The SLAM module has no drone-command interface. Thirteen offline tests passed on 20 September 2026, covering concurrency, bounded storage and target-loss policies.

Earlier project records contain single-Tello connection and flight evidence. The July E012 report explicitly marks passive SLAM and reacquisition integration partial. Fresh offline tests do not demonstrate flight performance, metric mapping or two physical Tellos.

A later E013 report dated 19 July 2026 records an airborne depth-scheduled following test: acknowledged takeoff/landing, 4.74 FPS effective tracking/control and two confirmed reacquisitions. This is a saved experiment report, not a new flight or an independent remeasurement. It retains an E012 run-ID prefix and explicitly labels ORB visual odometry advisory rather than navigation-grade SLAM.

sections.title: Ubuntu networking and communication degradation
paragraphs: The proposed multi-Tello topology assigns a USB Wi-Fi interface and Linux network namespace to each drone, with a worker process per interface and a central Ubuntu supervisor over local IPC. This separates address/routing contexts; it does not remove radio-frequency interference.

Video quality needs separate measurements of received resolution, decoded frame rate, packet loss, latency and corrupt frames. The existing reader does not expose all these measurements. Detector resizing is not established as the cause of poor video.

Next controlled experiment: passive recorded-video replay and software-injected message delay/loss, with seeded conditions, latency percentiles and event logs. Compare baseline supervision with confidence-aware isolation and reintegration. RF interference generation and live flight are outside this portfolio exercise.

sections.title: Bristol and Cranfield research threads
paragraphs: The local proposal matrix separates Bristol Hunt small-swarm organisation, relay/task allocation and collective reliability from Cranfield CRAN-0040 mission interpretation and CRAN-0041 trust-adaptive autonomy. These are historical proposal references, not affiliations, admissions or currently open funded opportunities.

Bristol’s current university profile supports Edmund Hunt’s small-team swarm research relevance. AirSwarm already addresses low-cost multi-UAV coordination, so using Tellos is not itself a novelty claim. An August 2026 Bristol preprint on collective ranking supplies a newer comparator for belief aggregation.
The Cranfield reference-number opportunities were not reverified on an accessible official current call page. Preserve the research ideas, but verify the call and supervisor before an application.

sections.title: One integrated programme
paragraphs: Air Marshal is the unifying experimental platform. CRAN-0091 contributes navigation and sensor reliability; the locally recorded CRAN-0040 and CRAN-0041 branches contribute human–swarm mission interpretation and trust-adaptive autonomy. Bristol adds collective reliability and small-team coordination. These strands share experiments and provenance while retaining distinct research questions.

sections.title: What the work demonstrates
paragraphs: The HMM dissertation’s saved reconciliation records 857 weekly observations, train-only preprocessing and prefix-only inference. It explicitly does not establish outperformance over gold buy-and-hold on a comparable window. This is historical replay evidence, not a fresh rerun here.

The MSc dissertation analysis is frozen pending supervisor input. Continuing gold and silver acquisition uses the same approved source families but is stored as a separate dated RESEARCH_CONTINUOUS product; those observations are not part of the frozen dissertation results.

Finance Lab contains experiment and rejection registries, Monte Carlo diagnostics, Benjamini–Hochberg multiple-testing controls, cost modelling and portfolio diagnostics. Its final matrix closes the candidate family with no pre-holdout eligible candidate and records an untouched holdout. These are valuable negative results.

The inspected source-input-only rebuild report is INVALID because the permitted raw datasets and full regeneration pipeline were absent from that upgrade root. Portfolio diagnostic inputs are labelled diagnostic; approved portfolio: none. The current ingestion stage refreshed gold and silver through 18 September 2026, with validation warnings retained.

sections.title: What makes this useful in a professional review
paragraphs: Show the research question, timestamped input manifest, frozen specification, temporal split, baseline and transaction-cost assumptions before presenting a result. Retain rejected candidates and distinguish exploratory trials from confirmatory evaluation.

For the metals desk, reconcile the gold decision/input date inconsistency, EWMA aggregate history, stale FRED observations and failed CME capture. Release-aware freshness must distinguish unchanged weekly data from failed ingestion. A new dashboard does not repair those source issues.

sections.title: Next demonstrable extension
paragraphs: Build an isolated research-only replay from licensed frozen inputs, regenerate ledger and report hashes, and compare a predeclared baseline under costs and stress scenarios. Report uncertainty and failed hypotheses. The current infrastructure can produce advisory and paper-state outputs, but it is not ready for total automated trading and has no real execution path.

A source-backed gap hypothesis is whether release-aware provenance and abstention improve the reliability of market-state decision support under delayed or revised inputs. Novelty remains unestablished; compare against existing backtest-overfitting and point-in-time evaluation research.

paragraphs: The bounded Central Command cycle refreshed local state and published a current brief. Application and project ingestion completed; Gmail and Calendar read-only access is verified, and the repaired Drive delta saw 10,287 checkpointed records, found 3 changes and ingested all 3. No external message or Drive write was attempted.

The Energy workbook REFRESH_AUDIT records daily V2 dispatcher entries through 20 September at 07:33 BST: US oil and gas observations dated 11 September, and ONS hydro updated to 18 September. GIE and ENTSOE are credential-blocked.

The migration and DATA_QUALITY tabs retain older July descriptions that conflict with later refresh records. Current trigger configuration was not independently inspected through the Apps Script API. Finance dashboard ports 8770 and 8765 refused connections in this check. The public portfolio remains available; original operational services are separate.

sections.title: Cloud migration design — proposed, not deployed
paragraphs: Preserve Ubuntu as an optional development and robotics edge device. Move bounded scheduled captures first: EventBridge schedule to a scoped worker, private versioned S3 for source snapshots, validation and quarantine, then a reviewed public summary. Store provider credentials in a managed secret store.

Add failure queues, alarms, idempotency keys and an independent restore check before retiring local schedules. Deploy one workload at a time and measure cost. The current live AWS deployment is the static portfolio, not this operational architecture.
Robotics latency-sensitive control remains at the edge. AWS can store approved experiment summaries and run offline analysis; the public dashboard is not a remote drone-control endpoint.

sections.title: Measured local work
paragraphs: The local vector RAG run ingested 218 documents into an FTS5/TF-IDF index, produced 219 chunks, and averaged 8.2 results across five test queries covering learning analytics, GPS-denied drones, the MSc metals work, actions and PhD research. The run reports PASS and records that no Drive bodies, Gmail bodies or OpenAI calls were read.

The graph layer contains 1,183 nodes and 3,095 edges, with project, topic, action and candidate-retrieval relationships. It reports PASS_WITH_WARNINGS because the graph is metadata-led and the Drive/Gmail bodies were not downloaded. The history-ingestion evidence records 47 conversations, 423 messages, 157 project links and 76 extracted actions.

sections.title: NotebookLM and agent boundary
paragraphs: Drive contains NotebookLM staging folders, index queues, source packs and an MSc OULAD source brief. These are useful evidence-pack and research-notebook artefacts: they show source curation and hand-off into NotebookLM, not a continuously refreshed NotebookLM service owned by this portfolio.

Agentic RAG produces review recommendations only. The Four-C governance rules prohibit external writes, finance orders, drone commands and submissions; retrieved text is treated as untrusted evidence and outputs remain provisional until a human promotes them.

sections.title: Hybrid architecture to complete
paragraphs: The next production-shaped step is a reproducible hybrid path: versioned source snapshots, a lexical/vector index, a graph projection for relationships, reranking with citations, freshness and sensitivity checks, then an approval queue. A scheduled refresh, independent restore check, evaluation set and public API are still required before calling this a live cloud service.

This separation lets the same evidence support the Air Marshal/CRAN research programme, the MSc learning-analytics work, financial research and the AIOS operating model without implying that historical logs are current autonomous operation.

sections.title: Recovered project and current coverage
paragraphs: The existing multi-PhD factory contains literature inventories, gap matrices and subject packs spanning drone autonomy, financial AI, education/privacy, graph AML, agents and energy. Its own missing-evidence report flags incomplete recent full text, empirical coverage, datasets and supervisor verification. The nominal RRIS Research Scanner folder contains only a starter README.

This refresh verifies selected primary records for robotics, quantitative evaluation and RAG evaluation. Education/privacy and AML remain in the catalogue with their coverage gaps; they have not silently become current systematic reviews.

sections.title: Three hypotheses to investigate
paragraphs: Robotics: does dependence-aware confidence and staged reintegration improve collective reliability under correlated sensing errors and delayed messages? Compare against simple averaging and the 2026 Gaussian-belief-propagation study. Measure calibration, ranking error, recovery time and message budget. Start in simulation; physical validation remains a separate gate.

Financial AI: does a release-aware quality gate improve reliability under delayed or revised metal-market inputs? Compare against a fixed-age freshness rule using frozen temporal splits; measure leakage violations, abstention and stability, not just selected returns. Existing backtest-overfitting research prevents claiming generic evaluation discipline as novel.

AIOS/RSS: can provenance and freshness gates reduce unsupported claims in research briefs? Compare retrieval-only, standard RAG evaluation and a provenance-gated workflow against human-labelled claims. Measure citation support, stale-source rate, abstention, latency and cost. RAGAS already evaluates retrieval/generation quality, so evaluation alone is not new.

sections.title: Search and review protocol
paragraphs: Search date: 20 September 2026. Queries included Bristol Edmund Hunt swarm robotics; Cranfield CRAN-0040/0041; AirSwarm 2503.06890; collective ranking environmental signals; RAGAS; probability of backtest overfitting. Include primary research relevant to the proposed mechanism and evaluation; exclude aggregators as factual authority, duplicates and unsupported summaries.

Current checks are abstract/metadata level for the cited preprints. Next: read full methods and limitations, search IEEE/ACM/publisher databases and backward/forward citations, record exclusion reasons, and obtain supervisor review. The accessible-source subset cannot prove that a gap exists.

For MSc review, map methods and results to the actual module rubric and final submitted version. For PhD review, add defensible originality, feasible access and evaluation design. No institutional assessment or admission is inferred.

sections.title: The official intent
paragraphs: Cranfield CRAN-0091 concerns resilient cognitive navigation with adaptive multisensor fusion for autonomous transport under degraded or unavailable GNSS. The official page lists a 30 September 2026 application deadline and 25 January 2027 start, checked 20 September. Eligibility and selection remain institutional decisions.

sections.title: Existing work that supports preparation
paragraphs: Ubuntu/Python Tello perception, telemetry and event logging support experimental engineering. E012 monocular visual odometry and target-loss policies provide an inspected starting point; 13 offline policy tests passed in this portfolio review. HMM temporal evaluation and AIOS provenance offer transferable methods for sequential data and reproducibility.

These are adjacent capabilities, not proof of completed PNT research. The current monocular output is unscaled; calibrated inertial/radio fusion, navigation ground truth, timing integrity and GNSS-denial validation are not established. Wi-Fi/video degradation is a communication issue and must not be equated with demonstrated GNSS resilience.

The later E013 historical flight report also supports practical integration experience: depth-scheduled following, event records and advisory visual odometry. It does not supply calibrated radio/inertial fusion or navigation ground truth.

sections.title: Proposal alignment and document lineage
paragraphs: The owner confirms that the statement intentionally combines personal Air Marshal interests with Cranfield navigation, human–swarm collaboration and trust-adaptive autonomy themes. The previous interpretation as an accidental mismatch is superseded. Original documents are preserved.

CRAN-0091 provides the cognitive-navigation emphasis within a wider programme. A call-specific proposal should explain this connection explicitly, identify a bounded primary contribution, and distinguish demonstrated capabilities from proposed integration.

sections.title: New runnable preparation experiment
paragraphs: A standard-library 1-D simulation compares a fixed-noise Kalman update with a 3-sigma innovation gate on the same 20 seeded scenarios. Mean position RMSE: fixed 1.2495, gated 0.1270, in synthetic units. The gated method has lower RMSE in 20/20 runs.

The scenario deliberately includes absent GNSS and biased radio measurements. It is an engineered illustration, not a trained AI model, real sensor evaluation or general performance claim. Ground truth is used only for scoring; tests check that changing truth cannot alter the estimates and future observations cannot alter a prefix.
Download the source bundle and run: python3 navigation_demo.py --output navigation-results.json. The source records fixed parameters, seeds, input hashes and per-run results.

sections.title: Work needed to address the full research intent
paragraphs: 1. Review navigation/fusion prior art and derive a defensible question. 2. Build a timestamped replay dataset with sensor calibration and independent truth. 3. Compare fixed, robust and learned fusion using identical splits and failure schedules. 4. Assess error, recovery time, covariance consistency, availability and runtime. 5. Test hardware-in-the-loop with suitable equipment and supervision.

The home lab can support initial software and perception work. Access to calibrated navigation sensors and suitable reference equipment is a research dependency. No airborne trial, active RF interference, admissions message or application submission is performed by this portfolio build.
